dct_description_sm:
Overview

This feature service contains shoreline unit information for the District of Peachland. It organizes the shoreline into mapped units and summarizes physical and planning characteristics used to support shoreline review and coastal planning.

Contents

  • Shoreline units with identifiers and mapped geometry for individual shoreline segments.
  • Unit attributes describing shoreline area, overall length, beach width, beach slope, beach character, development potential, and supported uses.
  • Adjacency and access context including nearby lots, docks, buoys, and buffer-related measures that help characterize shoreline use and surrounding development.

Geographic Coverage

The service covers shoreline areas in Peachland, British Columbia, within the Regional District of Central Okanagan.

Use Cases

  • Shoreline management and planning
  • OCP and waterfront policy support
  • Assessment of beach characteristics and development considerations
  • Review of shoreline access, docks, buoys, and adjacent land use context

Source and Stewardship

Data is owned by the district of Peachland, and is maintained by the GIS Section of the Regional District of Central Okanagan and is provided under the Regional District of Central Okanagan Open Data License.
